common.notFoundHint: Check the address or return to the dashboard
common.errorText: This looks like a temporary connection issue. Your funds and requests are safe — please try again.

connection.simulated: Demo data: not real market prices

auth.loginSubtitle: Your trading account, documents and notifications
auth.registerSubtitle: 2 minutes — and your demo account is ready
auth.registerSubtitleWithAmount: 2 minutes — and a {amount} demo account is yours
auth.riskNote: By opening an account you agree to the client agreement and risk disclosure.

home.stepVerificationText: Confirm your identity by uploading a document. It unlocks withdrawals and raises limits.
home.stepVerificationPending: Documents are under review — usually within one business day.
home.stepDepositText: Fund your live account with USDT (TRON network, TRC20). Credited after the transaction is verified on-chain, usually within a minute.
home.stepTradeText: Open the terminal and place your first trade — risk-free on demo or on your live account.
home.balanceDemoNote: Practice funds, no risk. Not withdrawable.
home.marketsClosedEmptyText: The list of permitted instruments for this site is empty — until something is added to it, no trading instruments are shown. The site owner makes the selection in the CMS.
home.marketsClosedUnavailableText: Could not load the instrument list. Please refresh a bit later.
home.marketsCatalogText: Instrument access is configured, but the market data service is not responding right now. The list will appear once the connection is restored.
home.marketsNoMatchText: Instruments are selected for this site, but none of them are currently quoted by the data source.
home.marketsNoTabsText: The Markets module is enabled, but all of its tabs are switched off in the site settings — there is nothing to show.
home.resetUnsetNote: Reset unavailable: the demo starting amount has not been set in the site settings.
home.resetUnavailableNote: Reset unavailable: the site settings could not be retrieved.
home.balanceNoAccountNote: The demo account opens on your first visit to the terminal — the terminal creates it, not the site.
home.resetAccepted: Accepted. The amount will update once the terminal applies the reset.
home.resetPositionsOpen: Close your open positions first: a reset with them would leave a balance from one life of the account and positions from another.
home.resetNotDemo: This is not a demo account — there is no starting amount to reset to.
home.resetRefused: The terminal refused the reset. The reason is in the log.
home.resetUnavailable: The terminal is unavailable, the reset was not sent. Try again later.
home.resetTooOften: Too often. Wait a minute and press again.
home.resetNoSession: Your session has expired — sign in again.
home.realFrozen: Trading and withdrawals are closed; open positions can still be closed. Contact support for details.
home.stepVerificationRejected: Verification failed. Upload the document again and we will review it once more.
home.liveUnavailableText: The terminal did not respond: equity and free margin will appear once the connection is back. Balance is as of the last reconciliation.

dashboard.applicationNone: Application not found — please contact support
dashboard.stepReviewHint: Upload your documents to speed up account opening
dashboard.demoHint: Virtual funds, real quotes. The trading terminal arrives in the next phase.

profile.title: Profile
profile.emailHint: Email change will be available once confirmations are enabled
profile.personalHint: Your name is shown in the account and documents. Language changes the interface and emails.

security.title: Security
security.sessionsHint: Revoke sessions on devices that are not yours

documents.title: Documents
documents.hint: Verification requires an identity document and a proof of address. PDF, JPG or PNG up to 10 MB.

kyc.title: Verification
kyc.hint: Upload your documents to complete verification. PDF, JPG or PNG up to 10 MB. Once submitted, your request goes to an operator for review.
kyc.submitted: Document submitted and queued for review.

stateText.unverified: Verify your identity to unlock withdrawals. Upload documents below; review usually takes up to one business day.
stateText.pending: Documents under review — usually up to one business day. We will notify you of the decision.
stateText.verified: Identity verified. Deposits and withdrawals are available.
stateText.rejected: Verification failed. Upload documents again and we will review once more.

kyc.emptyHint: Submitted documents will appear here with the submission date.

types.welcome: Welcome! Your {accountType} account application has been received; your demo account is already open.
types.documentUploaded: Document “{filename}” has been uploaded and sent for review.
types.demoReset: Demo account has been reset to the starting balance.
types.tradeExecuted: Trade executed: {side, select, buy {buy} sell {sell} other {{side}}} {volume} {symbol} at {price}.
types.marginCalled: Margin level {level}%. {remaining}% left before forced close-out at {stopOut}%. Equity {equity}, used margin {usedMargin}.
types.marginCalledNoStopOut: Margin level {level}%. No forced close-out level is set, so no margin close-out will happen. Equity {equity}, used margin {usedMargin}.
types.tradeExecutedWorse: Trade executed: {side, select, buy {buy} sell {sell} other {{side}}} {volume} {symbol} at {price}. That is {slippage} worse than your level {level}: a stop fills at the first observed price, not at the level.
types.tradeExecutedBetter: Trade executed: {side, select, buy {buy} sell {sell} other {{side}}} {volume} {symbol} at {price}. That is {slippage} better than your level {level}.

trade.title: Trading
trade.comingSoonHint: The trading terminal is not connected on this environment. Go back to your account — balances and operations are there.
trade.chooseLead: Choose an account — the terminal opens full screen. Use the “Account” button at the top to come back.
trade.realHint: Real funds in USDT. Profits are withdrawable.
trade.demoHint: Practice funds — same markets and instruments, no risk.
trade.realEmpty: No funds on the account yet.
trade.fullscreenNote: The terminal opens in this tab. On a phone, landscape works best.

validation.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters
validation.emailExists: An account with this email already exists
validation.accessRestricted: Access to your account is restricted. Please contact support.
validation.rateLimited: Too many attempts — try again in a minute
validation.unauthorized: Session expired — please sign in again
validation.unsupportedFormat: PDF, JPG and PNG are supported
validation.startBalanceUnset: The account cannot be opened right now: the demo starting amount has not been set. We do not substitute one — please contact support, it is fixed in the site settings.
validation.startBalanceUnavailable: The account cannot be opened right now: the site settings could not be retrieved. Please try again later — your form data is not lost.

history.title: History
history.unavailable: Trade history is temporarily unavailable — the terminal did not respond. This is our fault, not an absence of trades. Please refresh later.
history.slippageAgainst: Closed {amount} worse than your level {level}: a stop fills at the first observed price, not at the level.
history.gap: The price moved across a gap at that moment — there were no prices in between.
history.lead: Trades, positions, deposits and withdrawals for the account.
history.emptyHint: Open the terminal and place a trade — it will appear here with its result. Or pick a longer period.
history.emptyMoneyHint: Fund your live account with USDT — the request will appear here with its on-chain status.
history.closedDealsHint: Closed trades from the terminal: where a stop filled away from its level, we explain why.

money.onlyUsdtWarning: Other tokens and networks (ERC20, BEP20, etc.) are not credited — such funds may be lost permanently.
money.copyHint: After pasting into your wallet, check the first and last 4 characters.
money.minDeposit: Minimum {min}. Smaller amounts are not credited.
money.step2: Once the transfer is sent, paste its hash — we will find the transaction on-chain and credit the funds (usually about a minute after confirmation).
money.claimOk: Hash accepted. Verifying on-chain — the status will update in the history below.
money.addressMissing: Deposit details are being updated. Do not send funds to previously saved addresses — try again later or contact support.
money.withdrawOk: Request accepted, the amount is reserved. It will be sent after operator review.
money.withdrawPending: Request accepted; the reservation is being confirmed. See the status below.
money.withdrawNote: The amount is debited (reserved) immediately. If the request is rejected, the money returns to your account.

rejectReason.wrong_recipient: not sent to the exchange address

errors.unauthorized: Session expired — please sign in again.
errors.rateLimited: Too often — please wait a minute.
errors.invalidHash: A transaction hash is 64 hexadecimal characters.
errors.alreadyClaimed: This hash has already been claimed.
errors.usedByWithdrawal: This hash is an exchange payout, not a deposit.
errors.invalidAddress: Invalid TRON address: check every character (starts with T, 34 characters).
errors.amount_invalid: Amount must be a number, e.g. 25.50.
errors.amount_notPositive: Amount must be greater than zero.
errors.terminal_insufficient_free_margin: Not enough free funds: part of the balance is used by open positions.
errors.terminal_account_not_opened: Real account not opened yet — make a deposit first.
errors.terminal_account_quarantined: Account under review — please contact support.
errors.generic: Could not complete. Try again later or contact support.

money.depositLead: USDT on the TRON network (TRC20). Credited after the transaction is verified on-chain.
money.withdrawLead: USDT on the TRON network (TRC20) to your wallet. Sent after an operator review.
money.step1Title: Send USDT to the exchange address
money.qrLabel: QR code of the deposit address
money.txHashHint: Where to find it: in the wallet or exchange you sent from — History → this transfer → Transaction hash (TxID). 64 characters: digits 0–9 and letters a–f.
money.txHashInvalid: A hash is 64 characters: digits 0–9 and letters a–f. Make sure you copied all of it.
money.historyEmptyDepositsHint: Your requests and their on-chain verification status will appear here.
money.historyEmptyWithdrawalsHint: Your withdrawal requests and their status will appear here.
money.availableHint: Free margin — funds not used by open positions.
money.availableFallbackHint: The terminal did not respond — balance is shown. The terminal makes the final check of the available amount on submission.
money.withdrawAddressHint: TRON address: starts with T, 34 characters. TRON network (TRC20) only.
money.addressInvalidFormat: This does not look like a TRON address: it starts with T and has 34 characters (no 0, O, I or l).
money.confirmNote: The amount is reserved immediately. Blockchain transfers are irreversible — make sure the address is correct.

withdraw.no_client: Account not created yet. Please contact support.
withdraw.blocked: Account operations are restricted. Please contact support.
withdraw.frozen: Account frozen: withdrawals and new trades are closed; open positions can be closed.
withdraw.withdraw_banned: Withdrawals are restricted. Contact support for details.

money.walletLead: Deposits and withdrawals for your live account — USDT on TRON (TRC20).
money.historyEmptyOpsHint: Deposits and withdrawals will appear here with statuses and transaction links.
